result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a prominent spelling error in the search placeholder and an inconsistent favorite-icon style across restaurant cards.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder contains a typo: 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Update the placeholder text to read 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears as a bare outline, while the icon on the pizza card below sits on a dark circular background, creating inconsistent styling.
issues.suggestion: Use the same circular background treatment for all favorite icons across cards.
